snippet.title: Shatterflap - Trailer 2 - Incremental, Ricochet, Destruction.
snippet.description:
Play the free demo on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5122300/Shatterflap/

Fire bouncing balls into towering ceilings of ice, carve open new ricochet paths, and rescue hidden Penguins.

Shatterflap is a physics incremental game where every shattered piece of ice opens new possibilities. Earn Coins, grow stronger through permanent upgrades, load specialized ammo, and conquer increasingly tricky procedural levels.
